Now let me check if there's a built binary or if I need to build it. Let me check the submit.sh script and see what's available:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cat /workspace/submit.sh 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls /workspace/*.sh 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; find /workspace -name "fuzz-lxc-define-load" -type f 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls /workspace/</｜｜DSML｜｜>
